mainEntity.name: How much does a serious head injury attorney cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most serious head injury attorneys, including our firm, work on a contingency fee basis. This means you do not pay any upfront fees or hourly charges. Instead, the attorney's payment is a percentage of the compensation they recover for you, either through a settlement or a court award. If your attorney doesn't secure a recovery, you generally owe no legal fees. This fee structure makes legal representation accessible without immediate financial burden.
